# Third-party assets

- `google-maps-attribution.svg`: Google's own "Google Maps" logo, stored unmodified (WQ-26). It is the non-outlined gray logo for a plain background, `Google_Maps_Attribution_Assets/GoogleMaps_Logo_Gray/GoogleMaps_Logo_Gray.svg` from https://developers.google.com/static/maps/documentation/images/Google_Maps_Attribution_Assets.zip, linked from https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/policies ("Download the Google Maps attribution assets"). Do not edit or recolour it. It is the only file the colour scan excepts, by exact path.
